investment_strategy: Barbell AI strategy: anchor in lower-volatility, diversified AI platform exposure (Microsoft) for durable cash flows and broad commercialization, add high-momentum platform beneficiary (Alphabet) for search and cloud AI upside, and hold a capped satellite in AI infrastructure leader (NVIDIA) to capture accelerator demand while controlling export-control/geopolitical risk. Tilt aligns with themes of accelerating AI adoption, rising data center spend, and hybrid/on-device AI, while managing near-term volatility from regulation, antitrust, and power/capex bottlenecks. No reinvestment; review quarterly and rebalance to targets.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility with proven monetization paths, strong multi-year growth, and positive momentum; incorporated news on AI commercialization, export controls, antitrust, and power constraints; excluded names with declining growth or unfavorable momentum-risk tradeoffs.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive long term as AI diffuses across platforms, devices, and enterprise workflows; expect near-term volatility from regulation, antitrust, geopolitics, elevated capex, and power bottlenecks. Data center build and hybrid/on-device AI should continue to support leading platforms and infrastructure suppliers.
